name: The Movies That Made Us
s: These blockbusters brought us together and gave us the time of our lives. Meet the actors, directors and industry insiders who made them happen.

paragraphs.text: The Movies That Made Us is an American documentary television series created by Brian Volk-Weiss. It is a spin-off of The Toys That Made Us. The four episode debut season of the new series is dedicated to popular films from the 1980s and 1990s, and tells the stories behind them.
